title: Temporary leaders
subtitle: Invite by Google e-mail, with units and a deadline. When the deadline passes, access is cut automatically. It does not use the 1st or 2nd leader slot.
confirmEnd: End {{name}} access now? They lose access immediately (you can reactivate later).
confirmMakePermanent: Make {{name}} a regular leader (no deadline)? They become 1st or 2nd leader of the units.
deadlineHint: Today counts as day 1 and access lasts until 11:59 PM (Brasília) on the last day. You pick the date and can extend later.
modalSubtitle: The person signs in with Google using the e-mail below and lands as leader of the chosen units.
emailHint: It must be the Google account the person will sign in with. People who already have access do not need an invite.

errors.name: Enter the name (at least 3 letters).
errors.past: Choose a deadline that has not passed.
errors.noSlot: Unit {{unit}} already has 2 leaders. Free a slot before making permanent.

banner.today: Your temporary access ends TODAY at 11:59 PM.
banner.days_one: Your temporary access ends in {{count}} day ({{date}}).
banner.days_other: Your temporary access ends in {{count}} days ({{date}}).
banner.help: To continue, ask your mentor to extend it.

mentor.title: Temporary mentor
mentor.help: Gives access to {{mentor}} units for a set period, with the same access (including units they receive later). The person stays who they are: a mentor keeps their own units too. Several people can cover the same mentor. Only the admin can grant it.
mentor.keeps: Stays {{role}} and gains access to this mentor units until the deadline.
mentor.confirm: Give {{name}} access to {{mentor}} units until {{date}} 11:59 PM? After that date they go back to their previous access automatically.
mentor.done: {{name}} now covers the units until the deadline.
mentor.endConfirm: End {{name}} cover of {{mentor}} units now? They go back to their previous access.
mentor.bannerTitleToday: Your mentor cover ends TODAY at 11:59 PM.
mentor.bannerTitleDays_one: Your mentor cover ends in {{count}} day ({{date}}).
mentor.bannerTitleDays_other: Your mentor cover ends in {{count}} days ({{date}}).
mentor.bannerHelp: After that date you go back to your normal access. To continue, ask the administrator to extend it.
